scenes.headline: How a tiny net solves Sudoku
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Halcyon. Here's how an eight hundred thousand parameter model solves Sudoku that giant chatbots cannot.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Instead of writing an answer, LDT keeps the set of digits each cell could be and crosses out the impossible ones.
scenes.say: The trick is simple. Do not write the answer. Track every digit each cell might be, then rule out what cannot work.

steps.say: Every cell starts holding all the digits it could be. That whole grid of options is the lattice state.
A four layer transformer reads the whole grid and scores every candidate, sixteen times over in one pass.
Where its confidence drops near zero, that candidate is crossed out. The set of options only ever shrinks.
A check looks for a solved grid, or a dead end where some cell has no options left.
If it is stuck but still alive, it guesses one cell and loops again, tightening the grid.
When every cell holds one digit it answers. On a dead end it backtracks, and if it runs out it abstains.

left.title: A chatbot
items: Writes the answer token by token
left.say: A chatbot writes its answer one token at a time and can never unsay one. Here it scores zero.

right.title: LDT
right.say: LDT narrows a set of candidates it can prove sound. When it cannot be sure it abstains, never wrong.

scenes.title: Sudoku-Extreme solve rate
scenes.say: The scoreboard. Frontier chatbots solve nothing. Small reasoners reach the fifties and eighties. The eight hundred thousand parameter LDT solves them all.

scenes.label: solve rate on the full test set
scenes.say: One honest footnote. The paper claimed one hundred percent, but a full evaluation gives ninety nine point nine six. Rare misses, never wrong.

scenes.text: A tiny network that narrows a sound lattice can out reason models thousands of times larger.

recap: Hold a candidate set per cell
scenes.say: So, remember. Hold a candidate set per cell, narrow it soundly each pass, abstain instead of answering wrong. Thanks for watching!
